Driven as the REAL producer through the suite harness runSkillCopyPipeline (skills-conformance-check.test.ts) — copyDirectoryWithTransforms({ fileService: new InMemoryFileSystemService(...), srcPath: '/ds/packages/knowledge-hub/dataset/.skills', options: skillCopySyncOptions() }) — over an in-memory clone of the same fixture runChecks(root, join(root,'__no-installed')) judges on disk. fixScope.owner: checkInstallableLayout (packages/knowledge-hub/src/tools/skills-conformance-check.ts:944) — the gate's sole installer-layout verdict for the bounded flatten. At $base it implements only the SHALLOW half (validateNoShallowEntryWithSubdir); the DEEP half (validateNoDeepEntry) has no owner in the gate. collectInstallableDatasetFiles (:894) supplies its marker-blind file list and lives in the same module. checkEntrypointDepth (:835) is a marker-BOUND complement (`if (basename(file) !== 'SKILL.md') continue`), not a co-owner of the marker-blind deep rule, and is not modified.

domains.owner: checkInstallableLayout — the DEEP half (validateNoDeepEntry) it does not implement at $base
domains.discriminator: For each directory that holds files DIRECTLY (the producer's collectDirShapes view of the flat installable file list, root `.` exempt): (a) its depth vs flattenDepth (= ENTRY_DEPTH = 2) — <=2 never checked, 3, 4+; (b) whether its ancestor at EXACTLY depth 2 also holds files directly (present => the dir is CONTENT of that entry; absent => nothing owns it, entry too deep). Marker-BLIND in every branch: no SKILL.md knowledge on either the offender or the ancestor.
rows: D14 depth-3 dir holding a SKILL.md, ancestor@2 holds none -> REFUSE. Gate errors 1 at $base, from the marker-BOUND checkEntrypointDepth only. GREEN — pins the repair as ADDITIVE.
D15 depth-3 dir holding a NON-marker file, ancestor@2 holds none -> REFUSE. Gate 0 at $base. RED — the Critical finding.
D16 the same shape at depth 4 -> REFUSE naming the depth-4 dir. Gate 0 at $base. RED — forbids pinning the rule to depth 3.
D17 depth-4 content whose immediate PARENT holds no files but whose ancestor@2 does -> ACCEPT. GREEN — forbids testing the immediate parent instead of the ancestor at the entry depth.
D18 depth-3 content whose ancestor@2 holds only a NON-marker file -> ACCEPT. GREEN — forbids requiring a SKILL.md on the ancestor.

D19 a marker-less depth-3 offender BESIDE legal depth-3 content of a real entry -> REFUSE naming only the offender. Gate 0 at $base. RED — forbids a blanket 'any dir deeper than 2 that holds files' rule (which would break D17/D18) and forbids legal content masking an offender.
Live corpus (55 skills / 66 files) -> ACCEPT, checkInstallableLayout(SKILLS_DIR) === []. GREEN — whole-corpus over-correction anchor on real data.
domains.interactions: D19 is the cross-product of the refuse row (D15) with the accept row (D13/D17-shaped content) in ONE dataset: measured refusal blames 'capability/sub/foo' only, produced [].
